items.title: Steve Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I think it was Johnny Guarnieri actually.

ctx.x: Benny Goodman lived in a fog. He was Mr. Absent Minded and often didn’t know what he was doing. He’d walk on stage with his fly open and stuff. And through accident, he was just a careless man and didn’t think much about the world. He was just the greatest clarinet player of them all. So just after the movie, NBC and Universal Studios got together to do a little promotion going in both directions, so that meant booking Benny on our show, which was on the air Sunday nights at NBC at the time. So Benny himself…
I think it was Johnny Guarnieri actually.
Thank you, then you know the story?
